title: Accelerator cable mounting bracket
function: Anchors the cable outer housing while the inner cable pulls throttle linkage.
troubleshooting: Inspect mounting ears and cable housing retainer for looseness or cracks.
Check routing, housing seating and full return with engine stopped.
Missing linkage and cables prevent validating real operating travel.
